translations.web: The Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem; and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa.
translations.bsb: The Philistines gathered together and camped at Shunem, while Saul gathered all Israel and camped at Gilboa.
translations.kjv: And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered ➔ all Israel together, and they pitched in Gilboa.
translations.asv: And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa.
